== Description ==

[[Erik Spijksma]] (mid-left, glasses, dark hair, black *Return of the Jedi* poster tee), [[Scott Lingrell]] (right, navy Philadelphia Union jersey, white hair, glasses, name tag), [[Matt Thornton]] (mid, tan Rebel starbird cap, full beard, navy tee), and [[Joe Phillips]] at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
